notes.title: Major Update – BOT.vinnik Gets Even Sharper!
notes.content: [p]Greetings fellow chess enthusiasts,[/p][p][/p][p]Check out what's new:[/p][p]🔊 [b]New BOT.vinnik Reactions:[/b] We imported all the updated quotes and reactions directly from our newest game, making our beloved robot instructor even more expressive and sarcastic than ever.[/p][p]✏️ [b]Comprehensive Text Revision:[/b] Conducted a thorough review of all content, eliminating typos, improving syntax, and making texts clearer and more enjoyable.[/p][p]🖥️ [b]Windowed Mode:[/b] You can now easily switch between fullscreen and windowed mode by pressing [b]ALT + ENTER[/b].[/p][p]🛠️ [b]Bug Fixes:[/b] Addressed issues related to incorrectly swapped achievements.[/p][p]📈 [b]Gameplay Flow Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Clarified when clicks are necessary to proceed.[/p][/*][*][p]Immediate feedback for correct moves, removing the need to wait for previous incorrect comments.[/p][/*][/list][p]🎨 [b]Minor Visual Refinements:[/b] Subtle adjustments behind the chessboard for an improved visual experience.[/p][p]🚀 [b]New Splash Screen:[/b] Featuring our updated studio brand, Deep Green Games![/p][p][/p][p]And there’s more coming soon: in just [b]one week[/b], we’ll be releasing the demo of our newest title, [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3820000/BOTVINNIK_Chess_Masters_Academy"][b]BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy[/b][/url]![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3820000/BOTVINNIK_Chess_Masters_Academy"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Thanks for all the support, and see you on the chessboard![/p][p]— The Deep Green Games Team[/p]

notes.title: The BOT.VINNIK you’ve been waiting for is finally here!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, comrades!
[/h3]
You may have noticed we’ve been radio silent for a while—but there’s a good reason: we’ve spent the last few years working on the most ambitious BOT.VINNIK project to date!

🎉 BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy is now live on Steam:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3820000/BOTVINNIK_Chess_Masters_Academy/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3820000/BOTVINNIK_Chess_Masters_Academy/[/url]

This new game is the culmination of everything we’ve learned from the previous titles in the series. Alongside a brand-new visual style, it features:
[list]

[*] A reworked scoring system

[*] Structured progression across lessons

[*] Multiple difficulty levels

[*] A growing platform powered by future DLCs

[*] And even a beginner mode for those who don’t know how the knight moves yet

[/list]
Of course, BOT.VINNIK’s trademark sarcasm and brutal honesty are back and sharper than ever.

A free demo will be released soon — until then, check out the trailer and hit that Wishlist button to let BOT.VINNIK know you’re still worthy of being called "comrade."
(YouTube™ embed: “BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy – Reveal Trailer”)

Thanks for all the support over the years!
See you at the Academy.


Rodrigo & Eduardo
Deep Green Games

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/42471489/084ddadab27a86a52411acd976da250f6fbedd38.png[/img]
